column1: # Deception of summoned pets as the end-of-retail server used it. ACE's world database gives
# every skill of a summoned pet one number per tier, its essence's Summoning requirement. Retail's
# measured pets of a tier all had one Deception, so every pet of that tier takes it. Tiers with no
# stored: the Deception the database stores. retail: the tier's measured value. level: the pet's
# level. readings: how many times retail sent this pet's value (0: other pets of its tier were
# measured, not this one). name: the weenie's.
